relationships.subject: compound 36
relationships.evidence_quote: Among the new analogues, compounds 13 and 36 showed potent inhibitory activities against HDAC6 with IC<sub>50</sub> values of 12.5 and 8.5 nM, respectively

relationships.subject: compound 36
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, compound 36 suppressed the lipopolysaccharides (LPS)-induced microglia activation by inhibiting the levels of key pro-inflammatory cytokines (iNOS, COX-2, TNF-α and IL-6) in BV2 microglial cells.

key_findings: Novel diphenyl-oxadiazole HDAC6 inhibitors relieve inflammatory and paclitaxel-induced hypersensitivity
